reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001034 (the melody read from 001034a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. adapted, R. A. Smith has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1825, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001034a.nwc).
